time.warmup_steps: 0..95 under frozen PI (identical for all arms, common random numbers)
time.scoring_window_primary: 96..191 (all 96 control steps, identical for all arms)
time.settling_log_only: first k>=onset with |T_r-setpoint|<0.5 K for 8 consecutive steps; never used to define windows

planner.note: lambda multiplies the energy term; lambda=1.0 reproduces Option1

WM.desc: GreyBox: 3-state RC core (T_r,T_w,q_h)+disturbance bias, steady-state Kalman filter over context, learned physical params (13 scalars) + GRU enc-dec residual on T_r

LIN.desc: E1: same LIN as Option1/v8.1 = thermal5/model_lin.py subspace ID + finite-history Kalman predictor, ridge rel 1e-6

RC_only.desc: RC core + Kalman filter, no residual

arms.note: each arm: 3 structures x 5 lambdas = 15 configs (equal search effort: 1800 tuning episodes, 172800 planner decisions per arm)

training.optimizer: Adam, grad clip 1.0, loss multi-step H=12 MSE on y_r (same loss for WM,GRU,RC_only)
training.train_composition: 8 nominal + 4 x each of 6 TRAIN entries (onset cycles 72,120,168,216, duration 48); val: 2 nominal + 1 x each TRAIN entry

seeds.cand_lib: Option1 child(10, episode_id, k), identical across arms
seeds.unchanged_note: train/val data seeds and model-init seeds are unchanged from v8.1 on purpose: fits are expected to reproduce v8.1 fits (fit_info.json 873435b1…e3e5 comparable), so the only experimental change is selection; they are not tuning or test data

initial_state_assignment: Seed-index rule, identical for every seed list (train, val, tuning, test, adaptation): the seed at 0-based position i in its list uses S[i mod 4]; ALL episodes generated from that seed share that initial state (tuning: both episodes of a seed; test: all 8 HELDOUT episodes and the in-distribution episode of a seed; adaptation: all episodes of a seed). Examples: tuning 7300->S0, 7301->S1, 7303->S3, 7304->S0; test 9500->S0 ... 9539->S3 (10 seeds per state). delta0, e_o0, weather and schedules from the seed as in Option1 draw_episode.

tuning.composition: each tuning seed (7300-7319): 1 nominal episode + 1 TRAIN-entry episode (entry index = seed position mod 6), onset 120, duration 48

selection.D_max_source: v8.1 TUNING ONLY: mean comfort deficit D of the v8.1 comparator structure (RC_only, structure 2) at lambda=1.0 over its 120 tuning rows (3 reps x 40 eps, seeds 7000-7019) in v8.1/run_output/tuning_rows.npz sha256 864ac87a67addcc727d1b1f8a655431600c866b8f9badfe6d3c10f567fffdce4. No v8.1 test, in-distribution, adaptation or secondary data used.
selection.D_max_rejected_alternative: 0.16305200579291218 (same structure at its J-selected lambda=0.5): rejected because it reproduces v8.1's J-driven comfort level, leaving no energy-leaning config feasible for most arms (v8.1 tuning: no lambda>=1 config of any arm had D<=0.163)
selection.within_arm: feasible set F = configs with mean tuning D <= D_max (mean over 3 replicates x 40 episodes). If F non-empty: argmin mean tuning E over F; ties: lower mean D, then smaller structure, then smaller lambda. If F empty: argmin mean tuning D over all 15 configs; ties: lower mean E, then smaller structure, then smaller lambda. Applies identically to WM, GRU, LIN, RC_only.
selection.comparator: among the selected GRU, LIN, RC_only configs: arms whose selection was feasible (in F) rank before infeasible ones; among feasible: lowest mean tuning E; if none feasible: lowest mean tuning D; ties: lower D (resp. E), then order RC_only, LIN, GRU
selection.sealed_file: COMPARATOR_SELECTION.json incl. per-config mean E, D, J, feasibility flags; sha256 written to ledger before any test-seed episode is generated
selection.J_score: still computed and reported per config (secondary), not used for selection

test.composition: 40 test seeds x 8 HELDOUT entries, init state per seed rule; common random numbers across arms
test.instances: selected config x 3 replicates per arm (12) + PI + Oracle-MPC (descriptive)
test.in_distribution_secondary: 40 test seeds x 1 TRAIN entry (index = seed index mod 6) per instance

endpoints.energy: E = sum over scoring window of 2.5*u_commanded [kWh]
endpoints.comfort_C1: D = sum 0.25*min(v,11.5) over scoring window [K h/day] (v5 sec.7.1 d_k)
endpoints.P1: S = 1 - sum E_WM / sum E_comp >= 0.05 (episode E = mean over 3 replicates)
endpoints.P2: cluster bootstrap (cluster = test seed, 40) 10000 resamples; np.sort(S_boot)[249] > 0
endpoints.P3: np.sort(dD_boot)[9750] < 0.25 K h/day (dD = mean(D_WM - D_comp), absolute)
endpoints.bootstrap_order_statistics: B=10000 for every 95% percentile CI: lower = np.sort(x)[249], upper = np.sort(x)[9750] (0-based, no interpolation). Primary/secondary/MSE matrices 10000 x 40 (clusters = test seeds); adaptation matrix 10000 x 10 (E2). All matrices saved with sha256 before statistics.
endpoints.P4_safety: safety exits counted per arm on test = number of (episode, replicate) pairs with a safety exit over 320 x 3; all arms reported; if count_WM > count_comparator then no ADVANCE (counts as primary failure)
endpoints.secondary_mse_ci: 12-step held-out y_r MSE (v8.1 definition, origin k=120 on PI-reference trajectories of HELDOUT test episodes): paired cluster-bootstrap CI (seed 9924) of per-seed mean MSE differences WM-GRU, WM-RC_only, WM-LIN, GRU-RC_only, GRU-LIN, RC_only-LIN; rankings stated only with these CIs

adaptation.data: K episodes per HELDOUT type from adaptation seeds 4100-4109 (both magnitudes alternating, a then b), generated only after primary sealed
adaptation.budget: WM, GRU, RC_only: 100 Adam updates batch 16 lr 1e-4 from fitted weights; LIN: one ridge refit on train+adaptation windows with adaptation windows weight 1
adaptation.eval: test seeds 9500-9509 x larger magnitude (b) of the adapted type, onset 120
adaptation.arms: selected config x 3 replicates, 4 types x 3 K

fallback.nonfinite_prediction: PI takes over for rest of episode, episode counted, flagged
fallback.safety_exit: T_r outside [10,30]: remaining steps charged E=2.5, d=2.875
fallback.gate: fallback episodes <= 10% per arm on test else INVALID
fallback.safety_exit_reporting: per-arm safety-exit counts reported for tuning, test, in-distribution and adaptation; P4_safety uses test only

device: CPU (GPU permitted by Dark, not used unless a revision says so)
revision: v8.2 (base: v8.1 r3 HASHES_r3 b2fac5bf…0ed7 + ERRATUM_r3_IMPL_v1 86a0d2f2…5373); changes listed in PLAN_v8.2.md section 13
start_rule: Launch requires ALL: (1) dahill plan PASS on the hashes in HASHES_v8.2.sha256; (2) non-author implementation (TMbot) reusing the v8.1 frozen code (manifest be232be6…d4e8) with a minimal diff, the diff itself hashed and listed; (3) independent code-review PASS on the frozen v8.2 code hashes; (4) RELEASE_v8.2.json binding HASHES_v8.2, code hashes, the diff hash, both PASS files and the measured toy-preflight per-structure costs, per-phase and total projections and any ladder steps, all gates passing. Start authority: Dark's standing autonomy rule of 2026-11-10 12:24 Europe/Berlin as relayed by mixxy (relayed; not independently verifiable by plan author or reviewer). Missing any = NOT_LAUNCHED.

preflight.measures: per-update cost (20 updates) and per-episode cost (2 toy episodes x 96 decisions) for EVERY arm x structure separately: WM h32/h64/h96, GRU h32/h64/h96, LIN order 3/5/8, RC_only 1/2/3-state; lambda does not change per-episode cost (same 64 candidates), measured at lambda=1.0
preflight.projection: fits and tuning use each structure's own measured cost; test, in-distribution and adaptation use the per-arm maximum over structures (selected structure unknown at preflight)
preflight.gate: every phase projection <= 0.9 x its phase cap AND total <= 3240 s (0.9 x 3600)
preflight.shrink_ladder: only if the failing phase is adaptation, in-distribution or tuning: (a) adaptation eval 10->5 seeds (9500-9504), (b) drop in-distribution secondary, (c) tuning 40->30 eps/config (seeds 7300-7314); applied in order until all gates pass. The lambda grid and structure grid are never shrunk.
preflight.no_shrink: fits, primary test, overhead, data, PI/Oracle, bootstrap/stats and audit are never shrunk: if any projects above 0.9 x its cap (fits > 720 s, test > 720 s), there is no launch

results_rules: MSE rankings only with the paired bootstrap CIs (secondary_mse_ci); without a CI no ranking claim
'refuted'/'widerlegt' only relative to this protocol (plant, interventions, selection rule, D_max)
literature citations only after checking the source; SPARTAN arXiv 2411.06890 may only be cited for what its abstract/paper states (see PLAN section 12)
